en: Vintage monochrome postcard view of a wooded hill behind a small town or village. In the foreground are trees, gabled-roof houses and low white buildings. The background shows a forested hill labelled as Löbauer Berg, with a small tower structure on the crest identified as the Friedrich August Turm. Printed captions in German appear at the top of the card, including the locality Löbau i. Sa. and the spot Honigbrunnen.
